scope: Three-person closed-set temporal-split experiment; same recording per identity, no independent sessions or calibrated verification threshold. Settings fixed before reading new participants embeddings.
required_gallery: All three enrollment frames from each person must succeed; otherwise no complete cohort result. Do not optimize times.
failure_policy: Keep failed original-probe detections as failures in attempted-probe denominator, not evidence of anonymity.
alignment: Original landmarks for transformed embeddings; separate re-detection success counts. No embeddings or face crops saved.
